title: Report and dashboard-widget pickers show bare member names: the dataset member label and the dataset description never reach them (sub-issue of objectstack#20282)
body:
Sub-issue of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20282. Its lane reads "domain:spec parent + domain:services (service-analytics) sub-issue + objectui sub-issue (pickers)". Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` execution seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#19357) now that the parent's served shape has landed. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage.

**What the parent asks of objectui.** Its "reader that must exist" line reads: "objectui: the dataset / dashboard pickers show descriptions." The mainstream evidence it cites is Looker LookML's `description` (a field-picker tooltip) and Power BI's descriptions in the Fields pane.

**What the server serves now** (objectstack `main` `03cdb9a5c9`, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#20736, stage 3 of the parent):
- `GET /analytics/meta` returns `CubeMeta` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts:224`). It now carries the cube's `description`, each measure's `description` and `format`, and each dimension's `description`. `service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts#getMeta` copies them from the cube definition when they are declared.
- A cube compiled from a DATASET carries no `description` on `/meta`. `service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts#compileDataset` copies each member's `label` (as the cube `title`) and the measure `format`, and no description.
- The dataset document (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts`):
  - A member has a `label` (`I18nLabel`, `:118` and `:184`) and no `description`. The schema's guidance says "its author-facing text is `label`. `description` is declared on the DATASET itself" (`:112`, `:179`).
  - A measure has a `format` (`:261`).
  - The dataset has a `label` and a `description`, both `I18nLabel` (`:336`, `:337`).

**What the pickers show today** (objectui `main` `9a45088c4b`):
- Two inspectors bind a DATASET: the report inspector (`ReportDefaultInspector.tsx:284`–`:320`) and the dashboard-widget inspector (`DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx:130`–`:158`).
  - `useDatasetCatalog` lists `client.list('dataset')` (`useDatasetCatalog.ts:106`).
  - `useDatasetSemantics` hydrates `client.get('dataset', name)` (`:166`).
- `toCatalogEntry` (`useDatasetCatalog.ts:62`) keeps each measure's `name` and `aggregate`, and each dimension's `name` and `type`. It drops the member `label`, the measure `format` and the dataset `description`. So:
  - measure options read `name · aggregate`, and dimension options read the bare `name` (`ReportDefaultInspector.tsx:303`, `:313`; `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx:143`, `:147`);
  - the dataset picker shows the label and the name only.
- Nothing in objectui reads `GET /analytics/meta`: `git grep` for `analytics/meta`, `analytics.meta` and `CubeMeta` over `packages/**` and `apps/**` finds nothing. Neither inspector offers an authored cube (`analytics_cube`).

**Ask.** The two inspectors show the author's text beside the machine name:
- the member `label` on the measure and dimension options;
- the dataset `description` on the dataset picker.

Whether a picker should also offer authored cubes, and so read `/analytics/meta`'s descriptions, is for this card's triage.

**Carried from the parent's stage-3 review.** A dataset-bound picker that reads `/analytics/meta` will not find the dataset's `description` there: `compileDataset` copies none, the dataset's value is an `I18nLabel`, and `CubeMeta.description` is a string. That server half is not filed. If the design needs it, file it on objectstack and cite objectstack-ai/objectstack#20282.

**Acceptance:**
- Each inspector's measure, dimension and dataset options show the text above when the dataset declares it.
- They fall back to the name when it does not.
- A test pins each case.

Dedupe: this repo's open issues, searched for `picker description dataset`, `useDatasetCatalog`, `analytics/meta` and `dataset catalog measure label dropped widget inspector`, hold no card on these pickers. The nearest, #11095, is the KPI tile's invalidation subscription.
